paper.title: Algorithm 723: Fresnel integrals
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 19(4), 452-456 (1993); revised TOMS 22(4), 498-500 (1996)
paper.note: ACM article not read; the authors' Fortran (netlib TOMS 723.gz, sha256 checked) was run.

field: numerics (special functions: Fresnel integrals C, S, f, g)
stack: Fortran (double precision REAL*8 sources from netlib TOMS 723); built with GNU Fortran 16.2.0 (conda-forge) in the sandbox

claim.text: C(x), Fresnel cosine integral, double precision, at x = 1.0, as printed by the authors' double-precision driver DRDFRENL. Registered tolerance: abs 1e-6.

attempt: Ran the authors' double-precision sources (Drivers/Dp/driver.f and Src/Dp/*.f, unpacked verbatim from the archive, no source edit) with gfortran -O2 in the sandbox, objects named as the authors' makefile links them (driver.f compiled as drdfrenl.o). Two passes, each in a fresh run directory with the same binary, print C(1.0) = 7.7989340E-01, identical to the claim 0.7798934 (difference 0 at printed precision, inside tol 1e-6). The 25-row table of pass 1 matches the shipped Drivers/Dp/RES except for last-digit rounding in two entries (C at X=-4, S at X=-5, one unit in the 7th digit) and the zero-row formatting (.0000000E+00 in the shipped file). The claimed value is unaffected.

original_attempt.reason: The authors' Doc/makefile calls f77 (absent in the sandbox) and names drdfrenl.f, which the archive does not ship (the driver is Drivers/Dp/driver.f). make: No rule to make target 'drdfrenl.o' (exit 2). A retry with F77=gfortran still fails on the missing drdfrenl.f name (exit 2). The build used gfortran on the shipped files with the driver object named drdfrenl.o in a build directory outside the tree.

build_commands: gfortran -O2 -o drdfrenl drdfrenl.o dfrenl.o dcspxx.o dsnpxx.o dcospx.o dsinpx.o amach.o erfin.o ermsg.o derm1.o derv1.o
